name: Shamar Evans
strengths: Evans shoots the A-gap off the snap and drops the back in the backfield before the line can get a hat on him.
Evans drops, reads the quarterback's eyes, and steps in front of the throw for the interception.
Evans times the blitz, hits the quarterback, and rips the ball loose.
Evans closes from sideline to sideline and arrives with heavy contact.
weaknesses: Evans can play high into blocks and the downhill trigger will miss if he does not throttle on misdirection.
comparison: Evans comps to Cedric Gray — 6-2 / 220 rangy second-level LB who wins with burst, downhill trigger, and a knack for the ball.
projection: Evans projects as a Year 1 special-teams LB, then a Year 2 package WILL, with Year 3 starter upside if he adds 15 pounds and keeps the trigger clean.
schemeFit: Evans fits a downhill WILL / money LB who can blitz, fill, and still drop and play the ball.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from sophomore reel (embed 27177919 / 69022fe70d2241dbb0943c93), now at Ruston (LA). Comp height-matched at 6-2 — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Shamar Evans is a 2028 LB · listed 6-2 / 205 · Ruston (Ruston, LA) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the A-gap TFL and the zone pick; Evans creates takeaways.
insiderNotes: Evans is a lean 6-2 / 205 linebacker who shoots the A-gap for a tackle for loss, steps in front of the zone throw, and strips the quarterback on the blitz. The trigger is sudden. He still plays high into blocks.
